audience_strategy.goal: prioritize films and series people actively want to watch, search for and continue consuming after seeing Cena Certa
audience_strategy.availability_rule: where-to-watch information belongs only in the written post description, verified for Brazil on publication day; never spend narration time on platform availability

content_mix_strategy.nostalgia_rule: reserve at least one daily video for a culturally remembered film, preferably 1990-2010, with real rewatch appeal and current legal availability to mention in the written description
content_mix_strategy.nostalgia_1980s_exception: allow iconic 1980s titles only when cultural recall and audience demand are exceptionally strong
